description: The pie chart represents the distribution of characters, comparing virtual and real characters. The chart is divided into 12 slices, with the inner circle showing two main categories: "Virtual Characters" (blue) occupying approximately 70% and "Real Characters" (green) occupying around 30%. The outer circle further categorizes "Virtual Characters" into five subcategories: "Comic Characters" (light blue, about 25%), "Game Characters" (light blue, roughly 20%), "Novel Characters" (light blue, approximately 15%), "Teleplay Characters" (light blue, around 5%), and "Movie Characters" (light blue, about 5%). The "Real Characters" category is divided into seven subcategories: "Influencers" (light green, around 8%), "Actors" (light green, approximately 6%), "Musicians" (light green, about 5%), "Writers" (light green, roughly 4%), "Athletes" (light green, around 3%), "Artists" (gray-green, approximately 2%), and "Scientists" (pink, about 2%). The chart does not include a legend, but labels are provided for each slice. The slices are visually grouped by their respective main categories, with "Virtual Characters" and its subcategories in shades of blue and "Real Characters" and its subcategories in shades of green. The subcategories within each main category are arranged in a clockwise direction without an apparent order by size.
